# World Population Review

> > Comprehensive global population statistics and demographics for countries, cities, and US regions with live counters and 2026 projections.

World Population Review provides authoritative population data, rankings, and demographic analysis for countries worldwide (including India, China, United States, Japan, Nigeria, Brazil), major global cities, US states, and ZIP codes. The site features live population counters, historical trends, density metrics, and projections through 2026.

## Key Topics

## Core Population Data

- [Current World Population: 8,298,978,817](https://worldpopulationreview.com/): Homepage with live world population counter and country rankings
- [Total Population by Country 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries): Complete country population rankings led by India, China, US
- [Largest Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities): Global city rankings: Tokyo, Delhi, Shanghai, Dhaka, Cairo
- [US States - Ranking by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/states): US state population rankings: California, Texas, Florida, New York

## Country & Regional Rankings

- [G7 Countries 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/country-rankings/g7-countries): G7 member countries data: US, Japan, Germany and economic statistics
- [Bhutan Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/bhutan): Bhutan demographics and statistics with capital Thimphu data

## City Population Data by Country

- [Japan Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/japan): Japan city rankings featuring Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka
- [Egypt Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/egypt): Egypt city population data: Cairo, Alexandria, Giza, Port Said
- [Pakistan Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/pakistan): Population data for Pakistan cities: Karachi, Lahore, Faisalabad
- [Ukraine Cities by Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/cities/ukraine): Population rankings for Ukraine cities including Kiev, Kharkiv, Odessa

## US ZIP Code Data

- [ZIP Codes by Population](https://worldpopulationreview.com/zips): US ZIP code population data across Texas, New Jersey, Illinois, NY, CA
- [Mississippi ZIP Codes](https://worldpopulationreview.com/zips/mississippi): Mississippi postal codes for Olive Branch, Gulfport, DeSoto County
- [Montana ZIP Codes](https://worldpopulationreview.com/zips/montana): Montana postal codes for Kalispell, Billings, Flathead County
